reforms.description: The government promotes private initiatives through tax provisions and partnerships with industry to develop and diffuse technology, including a tax credit for research and experimentation expenditures. Additionally, the Advanced Technology Program facilitates industry-led partnerships to share costs for developing high-risk advanced technologies that private firms would not otherwise undertake, while the Manufacturing Extension Partnership (MEP) has expanded its network of technology extension centres to help small and medium-sized enterprises adopt appropriate manufacturing technologies.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These initiatives are designed to enhance technological development and adoption, which supports economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: All programs mentioned are stated to be implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: These reforms significantly enhance the support for innovation but do not represent a structural overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: The Manufacturing Extension Partnership (MEP), which links universities, communities, and government through a nation-wide network of technology extension centres to help SMEs adopt appropriate manufacturing technologies, has expanded from 7 to 44 centres.
